payload_preview.body_html: COMPACT SIZE: Measures 5.3 x 4.2 x 2.1 inches and weighs just 0.23 lbs, fitting tanks of various sizes without crowding swimming space. PET-SAFE MATERIAL: Crafted from premium resin that will not fade or leach harmful substances, keeping your aquatic habitat safe and vibrant. FLOATS ON WATER SURFACE: Perfectly balanced to bob gently on the water, creating dynamic movement and a relaxing vacation atmosphere in your tank. VERSATILE USE: Great for indoor fish tanks, outdoor water gardens, terrariums, and tabletop fountains for a whimsical touch. CHARMING DESIGN: Adorable resin frog lounging on a swim ring brings a playful summer vibe to any aquarium or pond.
